sentences.en: A Tourism, holidaymaking and travel are these days more significant social phenomena than most commentators have considered.
sentences.zh: 旅游、节假日和旅行是当今比大多数评论家认为更为重要的社会现象。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: On the face of it there could not be a more trivial subject for a book and indeed since social scientists have had considerable difficulty explaining weightier topics such as work or politics it might be thought that they would have great difficulties in accounting for more trivial phenomena such as holidaymaking.
sentences.zh: 书本的题目实在是微不足道,而且实际上由于社会科学家在解释诸如工作或政治等较重大的主题方面相当困难,人们可能会认为,他们很难解释节假日等较不重要的现象。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: However there are interesting parallels with the study of deviance.
sentences.zh: 然而,与异常研究有有趣的平行之处。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This involves the investigation of bizarre and idiosyncratic social practices which happen to be defined as deviant in some societies but not necessarily in others.
sentences.zh: 这涉及调查一些社会内、但不一定在另一些社会内被界定为异常的奇特和特异的社会做法。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The assumption is that the investigation of deviance can reveal interesting and significant aspects of normal societies It could be said that a similar analysis can be applied to tourism.
sentences.zh: 假设是,对偏离情况的调查可以揭示正常社会有趣的重要方面。 可以说,类似的分析可以适用于旅游业。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B Tourism is a leisure activity which presupposes its opposite namely regulated and organised work.
sentences.zh: B 旅游业是一种休闲活动,其先决条件是相反的,即有管制和有组织的工作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: It is one manifestation of how work and leisure are organised as separate and regulated spheres of social practice in modern societies Indeed acting as a tourist is one of the defining characteristics of being modern’ and the popular concept of tourism is that it is organised within particular places and occurs for regularised periods of time.
sentences.zh: 这也是现代社会如何将工作和休闲作为社会实践中独立和受监管的领域的一种表现。 旅游是现代的决定性特征之一,而流行的旅游业概念是,它是在特定地点组织起来的,并且定期进行。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Tourist relationships arise from a movement of people to and their stay in various destinations.
sentences.zh: 旅游关系产生于人们前往不同目的地并停留在不同目的地。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This necessarily involves some movement that is the journey and a period of stay in a new place or places.
sentences.zh: 这必然涉及某种流动,即旅程和在新地点停留的时间。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The journey and the stay are by definition outside the normal places of residence and work and are of a short term and temporary nature and there is a clear intention to return “home within a relatively short period of time.
sentences.zh: 旅行和停留按定义是在正常的居住和工作地点之外,属于短期和临时性质,显然打算“在较短的时间内回家”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: C A substantial proportion of the population of modern societies engages in such tourist practices new socialised forms of provision have developed in order to cope with the mass character of the gazes of tourists as opposed to the individual character of travel.
sentences.zh: 现代社会相当大比例的人口从事这种旅游活动,为了应付游客凝视的群众性,而不是旅行的个人性,已经发展出新的社会化提供形式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Places are chosen to be visited and be gazed upon because there is an anticipation especially through daydreaming and fantasy of intense pleasures, either on a different scale or involving different senses from those customarily encountered.
sentences.zh: 选择参观和注视的地方是因为人们特别通过日梦和幻想,期待到不同规模或与习惯上遇到的强烈的乐趣,或涉及不同感官。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Such anticipation is constructed and sustained through a variety of non-tourist practices such as films TV literature, magazines records and videos which construct and reinforce this daydreaming.
sentences.zh: 这种预期是通过各种非旅游做法构建和维持的,如电影电视文献、杂志记录和视频等,这些都形成和加强这一日间梦。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: D Tourists tend to visit features of landscape and townscape which separate them off from everyday experience.
sentences.zh: 旅游者往往参观地貌和城镇景色,使他们与日常经历脱钩。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Such aspects are viewed because they are taken to be in some sense out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 之所以看待这些方面,是因为人们认为它们在某种程度上是不正常的。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The viewing of these tourist sights often involves different forms of social patterning with a much greater sensitivity to visual elements of landscape or townscape than is normally found in everyday life.
sentences.zh: 观看这些旅游景点往往涉及不同形式的社会模式,对景观或城镇景色的视觉要素比日常生活通常更加敏感。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: People linger over these sights in a way that they would not normally do in their home environment and the vision is objectified or captured through photographs postcards films and so on which enable the memory to be endlessly reproduced and recaptured.
sentences.zh: 人们在这些景点上停留,通常不会在家里环境中这样做,通过照片明信片片电影等,将视觉化为人知或捕捉,使记忆能够无休止地复制和重新恢复。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: E One of the earliest dissertations on the subject of tourism is Boorstins analysis of the pseudo event (1964) where he argues that contemporary Americans cannot experience reality’ directly but thrive on “pseudo events”.
sentences.zh: 有关旅游主题的最早论文之一E是Boorstins对假事件(1964年)的分析,他争辩说,当代美国人不能直接体验现实,而只能靠 " 假事件 " 来发扬光大。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Isolated from the host environment and the local people the mass tourist travels in guided groups and finds pleasure in inauthentic contrived attractions gullibly enjoying the pseudo events and disregarding the real world outside.
sentences.zh: 大批游客与东道环境和当地人民隔绝,他们以导游群的形式旅行,并感到愉快的是,那些不真实的、自造的景点容易被人们所享受,而无视外面的现实世界。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Over time the images generated of different tourist sights come to constitute a closed self-perpetuating system of illusions which provide the tourist with the basis for selecting and evaluating potential places to visit.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移,不同旅游景点产生的图像形成了一种封闭的自我永续幻想系统,为游客提供了选择和评估可能访问的地点的基础。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Such visits are made says Boorstin, within the “environmental bubble of the familiar American style hotel which insulates the tourist from the strangeness of the host environment.
sentences.zh: Boorstin说,这种访问是在“熟悉的美国风格的旅馆的环境泡沫中进行的,这种环境泡沫使游客远离东道环境的奇特性。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: F To service the burgeoning tourist industry, an array of professionals has developed who attempt to reproduce ever-new objects for the tourist to look at.
sentences.zh: 为了服务于蓬勃发展的旅游业,一系列专业人员培养出一种为游客寻找的、试图复制新物品的专业人员。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: These objects or places are located in a complex and changing hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 这些物体或地点位于复杂和不断变化的等级体系中。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This depends upon the interplay between, on the one hand, competition between interests involved in the provision of such objects and, on the other hand changing class, gender, and generational distinctions of taste within the potential population of visitors.
sentences.zh: 这取决于提供此类物品所涉利益与改变类别、性别和游客潜在人口之间不同世代之间不同口味之间的竞争之间的相互作用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It has been said that to be a tourist is one of the characteristics of the “modern experience.
sentences.zh: 据说,旅游是“现代经验”的特点之一。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Not to go away is like not possessing a car or a nice house.
sentences.zh: 不离开就像没有车或房子一样。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Travel is a marker of status in modern societies and is also thought to be necessary for good health.
sentences.zh: 旅行是现代社会地位的一个标志,也是健康所必须的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The role of the professional, therefore, is to cater for the needs and tastes of the tourists in accordance with their class and overall expectations.
sentences.zh: 因此,专业人员的作用是,根据游客的阶级和总体期望,满足游客的需要和口味。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
